title: Insecure PHP File Upload Handling
description: Improper validation of PHP file uploads allows attackers to upload malicious files and achieve remote code execution.
businessImpact: High --- uploaded web shells can lead to full web server compromise, data theft, and persistent backdoors that threaten the integrity of business operations and customer data.
remediation:
- Restrict allowed extensions and MIME types.
- Store uploads outside of webroot and disable execution in upload directories.
- Implement antivirus scanning and randomized filenames.
- Regularly patch PHP and web server software.
